blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — Police arrested three suspected drug traders—two of whom have previous drug cases—in separate buy-bust operations in this city on Thursday, Sept. 17. Cops also seized more than P592,000 worth of suspected “shabu” (crystal meth), authorities said. Lucena City police chief Lt. Col. Ryan Hernandez said in a report that operatives from the Drug Enforcement Unit arrested a 34-year-old suspected street-level drug pusher and his cohort.
